title: The Bird in the Dirt
lines: Kim is a girl in a red shirt.
She spots a bird sitting in the dirt.
Its wing is bad, and it can not fly.
Kim goes to pick it up, and it hops off.
First she gets a box and a soft rag.
She sets the box in the dirt by it.
The bird turns and hops into the box.
Her mother turns a lamp on for it.
The bird curls up and naps.
On the third sun up, the wing is fine.
Kim lets it go. It lifts up and turns.

questions.ask: What was wrong with the bird?
questions.listenFor: Its wing was bad, so it could not fly. 'It was in the dirt' is where it was, not what was wrong.

questions.ask: How did Kim get the bird into the box?
questions.listenFor: She set the box in the dirt next to it, and the bird hopped in on its own. If they say "she picked it up," ask "what happened when she went to pick it up?"

questions.ask: Which part will you draw — the bird in the box, or the bird lifting off?
questions.listenFor: Either. Line seven is the box; the last line is the bird going. Ask what made them pick it.
